units.source_text: “在这种地方跳，一分钟就可以了，可是……真迟钝啊，太优柔寡断了。”

en.t: “If I jumped in a place like this, one minute would be enough, but... I really am slow, far too indecisive.”
The seventh-dan player smiled, his face slightly flushed,

units.source_text: “到底要这样跳还是爬，我思考了三个半小时也……”

en.t: “I spent three and a half hours thinking about whether I should jump like this or climb after all, and still...”
